name: HANS-TECHY-V2
description: Multi-Device WhatsApp Bot created by HANS TECHY

SESSION_ID.description: Enter your WhatsApp SESSION_ID here (or leave empty if using pairing code / QR code).

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp phone number with country code, digits only (e.g. 255770417445).

MODE.description: Bot operational mode: 'public' (accessible to all) or 'private' (owner only).

AUTO_VIEW_STATUS.description: Automatically view WhatsApp contact statuses (true or false).

AUTO_LIKE_STATUS.description: Automatically react with emoji to WhatsApp statuses (true or false).
